errors.page_forbidden: You can read this page but not do that with it.
errors.invalid_title: A page title has at most 200 characters.
errors.invalid_icon: That is not one of the page icons.
errors.place_mismatch: A sub-page is always in the same place as the page it is under.
errors.page_changed: This page changed since you saw it. Reload it and try again.

errors.foreign_blob: The change names a file that was not uploaded to this page.

errors.share_yourself: Choose someone else to share it with.
errors.invalid_ref: A page can't link to that kind of record.
errors.invalid_import: Choose between 1 and 100 pages to import.
errors.no_conflict: That block has no change waiting from Notion.
errors.conflict_block_gone: The block this change is about is not in the page any more.
